resumeText:
Meenakshi Raghavan | Chennai | meenakshi.r@example.com

SUMMARY
IT program manager with 15 years in banking technology, running multi-project modernisation programs for a large lender.

EXPERIENCE
Senior IT Program Manager, Kaveri Financial Technologies, Chennai (2020 - present)
- Run a core banking modernisation program of nine projects with an integrated plan, RAID log and cross-project dependencies.
- Set up the program steering committee and stage-gate reviews with the CIO and business sponsors.
- Own the program budget and report budget vs actuals and forecasts to finance every month.
- Wrote the business case and cost-benefit analysis for the payments platform replacement.
- Manage three system integrators against statements of work and quarterly supplier performance reviews.
- Align business heads, IT leaders and vendors on scope and release priorities.
- Write monthly executive status reports and steering committee packs for the CIO.

IT Project Manager, Adyar Systems, Chennai (2016 - 2020)
- Managed project plans, scope and schedules for a loan origination rollout across 400 branches.
- Ran change control and go-live readiness checks with the bank's operations team.

Business Analyst, Adyar Systems, Chennai (2011 - 2016)
- Wrote functional specifications for retail lending systems.

SKILLS
Program management, Agile, MS Project, Excel, PowerPoint

EDUCATION
BTech Information Technology, Anna University, 2011
MBA (part-time), 2015

CERTIFICATIONS
PMP (2017)
